widespread.en: The novel caused immediate and widespread offence among Muslim communities around the world.
widespread.zh: 这部小说在世界各地的穆斯林群体中引起了立即且广泛的冒犯感。

widespread.en: Storm surge, that's that body of water that gets swept inland and produces widespread flooding.
widespread.zh: 风暴潮，就是那股被卷入内陆并造成大范围洪灾的水体。

widespread.en: This tough rhetoric and his decisive actions won him widespread support.
widespread.zh: 这种强硬的言论和果断的行动赢得了他广泛的支持。

widespread.en: In a place like Sierra Leone where corruption is widespread, what happens?
widespread.zh: 在像塞拉利昂这样腐败蔓延的地方，会发生什么呢？

widespread.en: Governments can collect taxes and then invest their money and enforce laws and stop corruption from becoming widespread.
widespread.zh: 政府可以收税，然后投资资金，执行法律，并阻止腐败蔓延。

win.en: And I won the beginner or the lower intermediate category in the speech contest.
win.zh: 我在演讲比赛中获得了初级或中初级组的冠军。

win.en: Marie Skłodowska Curie became the first woman ever to win a Nobel Prize.
win.zh: Marie Skłodowska Curie 成为历史上第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性。

win.en: And finally, small wins are minor successes which contribute to a larger life goal.
win.zh: 最后，“small wins”是微小的成功，它们有助于实现更大的生活目标。

win.en: And finally, a winning formula is a method or strategy that produces successful results.
win.zh: 最后，致胜法宝是一种产生成功结果的方法或策略。

win.en: The PAP won the 1959 election, and Lee Kuan Yew became Singapore’s first prime minister.
win.zh: 人民行动党赢得了1959年的选举，李光耀成为新加坡第一任总理。

within.en: Within a month, Tunisia’s president, Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, had fled the country.
within.zh: 不到一个月，突尼斯总统 Zine El Abidine Ben Ali 就逃离了国家。

within.en: The reserve army would have arrested the supposedly “disloyal” elements within the Nazi party.
within.zh: 后备军本会逮捕纳粹党内所谓的“不忠”分子。

within.en: It is the idea that many different identities can exist within the same country.
within.zh: 它是这样一种理念：许多不同的身份认同可以共存于同一个国家之内。

within.en: Within months, his men had helped capture the cities of Waterford and Dublin.
within.zh: 几个月内，他的部下就协助攻占了沃特福德和都柏林。

within.en: My first speech contest attempt was in 2017, within the first year of me studying Japanese.
within.zh: 我第一次尝试演讲比赛是在2017年，那是我学习日语的第一年。

withdraw.en: Then the flight response is when people try to protect themselves by withdrawing or avoiding.
withdraw.zh: 然后“逃跑”反应是人们试图通过退缩或回避来保护自己。

withdraw.en: He refused a knighthood, turned down honours, and withdrew from public life.
withdraw.zh: 他拒绝了爵位，谢绝了荣誉，并退出了公众生活。

withdraw.en: And he simply disappeared, or at least withdrew completely from society.
withdraw.zh: 他索性消失了，或者说彻底退出了社会。

withdraw.en: His teachers described him as “quiet”, “withdrawn”, even “timid”.
withdraw.zh: 他的老师形容他“安静”、“内向”，甚至“胆小”。

withdraw.en: If you visit the UK and you withdraw a £50 bank note, you will notice Alan Turing’s portrait on one side.
withdraw.zh: 如果你访问英国并取出面值 50 英镑的纸币，你会注意到上面印有 Alan Turing 的肖像。

willing.en: Parliament is desperate for the king to recover and is willing to try anything.
willing.zh: 议会迫切希望国王康复，愿意尝试任何方法。

willing.en: ‘Cause feedback is really important. A growth mindset involves being willing to change, right?
willing.zh: 因为反馈真的很重要。成长型思维包含着愿意改变的意愿，对吧？

willing.en: If you are open-minded, you are willing to listen to and consider new ideas.
willing.zh: 如果你 open-minded，你就愿意倾听并考虑新的想法。

willing.en: Mindset can also affect the kind of challenges that people are willing to take.
willing.zh: 思维方式还会影响人们愿意接受什么样的挑战。

willing.en: In 1989, France wanted him out but was willing to be polite about it.
willing.zh: 在1989年，法国想让他走，但还愿意保持礼貌。

widely.en: Yet people vary widely in their ability to identify, understand and manage emotional signals.
widely.zh: 然而，人们在识别、理解和管理情绪信号的能力上，却存在很大差异。

widely.en: His death is widely believed to have been suicide, though some details remain debated.
widely.zh: 人们普遍认为他的死是自杀，尽管一些细节仍存争议。

widely.en: And as of early 2026, JD Vance is widely seen as the most likely Republican candidate.
widely.zh: 截至2026年初，JD Vance 被普遍视为最有可能代表共和党参选的候选人。

widely.en: It made certain foods cheaper. Certain foods were now available more widely.
widely.zh: 它使某些食物变得更便宜。某些食物现在的供应范围更广了。

widely.en: Facebook pages sprang up calling for demonstrations, and videos of the Tunisian protests were shared widely.
widely.zh: 呼吁示威的 Facebook 页面如雨后春笋般涌现，突尼斯抗议活动的视频也被广泛分享。

winner.en: Ah yes, I asked you earlier, "Who is the winner of the most Michelin stars ever?"
winner.zh: 啊是的，我之前问过你：'有史以来获得米其林星级最多的人是谁？'

winner.en: Ooh, I'm going to say Patrick Callahan is the winner of the 2024 Mister Universe bodybuilding contest.
winner.zh: 噢，我要说帕特里克·卡拉汉是2024年环球先生健美比赛的冠军。

winner.en: And in a democracy, those people will outnumber the winners and they will vote the winners down.
winner.zh: 在民主制度下，这些人的人数会超过赢家，他们会投票否决赢家。

winner.en: And in a democracy, those people will outnumber the winners and they will vote the winners down.
winner.zh: 在民主制度下，这些人的人数会超过赢家，他们会投票否决赢家。

winner.en: And I said he was the winner of the Mister Universe contest.
winner.zh: 我说他是环球先生比赛的冠军。

wine.en: So I wonder, does that render the wine competition a pointless exercise?
wine.zh: 那我想问，这是不是意味着葡萄酒大赛其实毫无意义？

wine.en: Being a wine judge, David, of course disagrees, using the phrase, but I would say that, wouldn't I?
wine.zh: 作为一名葡萄酒评委，David 当然不同意这种说法，他用了一句话：'我当然会这么说，不是吗？'

wine.en: Is happiness the fleeting pleasure of a slice of rich chocolate cake, or a glass of wine after a long day at work?
wine.zh: 幸福是吃一块浓郁巧克力蛋糕时的短暂愉悦，还是工作了一整天后喝上一杯红酒的快乐？

wine.en: Nobody seemed to have told the young emperor anything; nobody had slipped over on a stray grape or spilled the wine over someone’s head.
wine.zh: 似乎没人给这位年轻的皇帝讲过什么事；没人踩在落单的葡萄上滑倒，也没人把酒洒在别人的头上。

wine.en: Here, she tells Ruth Alexander, presenter of BBC World Service programme The Food Chain, how it all got started: What happened is I had graduated from the Prue Leith College of Food and Wine and decided to send my CV to all the three-Michelin-star restaurants that I could find at that moment in the Michelin Guide.
wine.zh: 在这里，她向 BBC World Service 节目 The Food Chain 的主持人 Ruth Alexander 讲述了这一切是如何开始的：“当时的情况是，我刚从 Prue Leith College of Food and Wine 毕业，决定把我的 CV 寄给当时我在《米其林指南》中能找到的所有米其林三星级餐厅。”

wire.en: The learner would be strapped into a chair with electrical wiring so they couldn't escape.
wire.zh: “学生”会被绑在一张接有电线的椅子上，无法逃脱。

wire.en: Many were humiliated before being sentenced to death by hanging, strangled slowly with piano wire.
wire.zh: 许多人在被判处绞刑前受到羞辱，用钢琴线被缓慢勒死。

wire.en: There are stacks of used wooden pallets and big reels for holding wires.
wire.zh: 这里有一堆堆用过的木托盘和用来装电线的巨大卷轴。

wire.en: There were two opposing ideologies facing each other across a line of concrete and barbed wire.
wire.zh: 在一条由混凝土和带刺铁丝网构成的分界线上，有两个相互对立的意识形态在对峙。

wire.en: It's, like, the way that you think. Our brains – they're wired to, I think, process information differently.
wire.zh: 就像是，你的思考方式。我们的脑部结构——我认为它们天生就是以不同的方式来处理信息的。

wild.en: No trial. This was the “Wild” West, but even here, this crossed a line.
wild.zh: 没有审判。这里是“狂野”的西部，但即便如此，这也已经越过了底线。

wild.en: Domestication is when wild animals become controlled by humans for work, food or as pets.
wild.zh: domestication(驯化)是指野生动物被人类控制，用来劳作、食用或作为宠物。

wild.en: The Wild West had found its hero. The only problem was that he’d never really existed.
wild.zh: 荒野西部找到了自己的英雄，唯一的问题是，这个英雄其实从未真正存在过。

wild.en: And I remember the first month of rent that I paid, this is actually wild.
wild.zh: 我记得我付的第一个月房租，这其实很疯狂。

wild.en: The dinosaurs and the wild aurochs are two examples of extinct animals.
wild.zh: 恐龙和野生原牛就是两个已灭绝动物的例子。

wisdom.en: Yeah. She's so central to your story, to much of the wisdom you have.
wisdom.zh: 是的。她对你的故事，对你拥有的许多智慧是如此核心。

wisdom.en: I just noticed like, wow, he's probably has 60 to 80% of my knowledge and development wisdom.
wisdom.zh: 我注意到，哇，他可能已经拥有了我60%到80%的知识和发展智慧。

wisdom.en: That is a conventional wisdom. That may even be the practical earned experience of your reality.
wisdom.zh: 那是传统观念。这甚至可能是你现实中通过实践得出的经验。

wisdom.en: A nugget means a small piece of something good, like wisdom, or precious, like a nugget of gold.
wisdom.zh: “Nugget”指的是一小块好东西，比如智慧，或者珍贵的东西，比如金块。

wisdom.en: The one time I've had divine inspiration, three in the morning, wake up with the name was Modern Wisdom.
wisdom.zh: 只有那一次，我有过神来之笔，凌晨三点醒来想到的名字是Modern Wisdom。

wing.en: Let's go get some chicken wings. There was somebody accepting you despite your failure.
wing.zh: 我们去吃炸鸡翅吧。有人在接受你，尽管你失败了。

wing.en: I asked you how many times bees flap their wings per second.
wing.zh: 我问过你蜜蜂每秒扇动翅膀多少次。

wing.en: There were violent clashes between the radical left and right wing groups and repeated challenges to democracy.
wing.zh: 激进的左翼和右翼集团之间发生了暴力冲突，对民主的挑战也不断出现。

wing.en: The buzzing sound bees are famous for is made by flapping their four wings incredibly fast, but how fast?
wing.zh: 蜜蜂闻名遐迩的嗡嗡声是由它们以极快的速度拍打四翅产生的，但速度有多快呢？

wing.en: They're like, no, your friend was there going like, do you want to go get some chicken wings?
wing.zh: 他们就像，不，你的朋友在那儿说，你想去吃炸鸡翅吗？

wink.en: Oh, sorry, Georgie, I was er, just, catching forty winks … you know, getting some shut-eye, dozing, taking a nap...
wink.zh: 哦，抱歉，Georgie，我刚刚在……眯一会儿呢……你知道的，闭眼休息一下，打个盹，小睡一下……

wink.en: OK, let's recap the vocabulary we've learned starting with the phrases catch forty winks, get some shut-eye, doze and take a nap, all of which mean to sleep.
wink.zh: 好了，让我们回顾一下学到的词汇，首先是 catch forty winks、get some shut-eye、doze 和 take a nap，这些短语的意思都是睡觉。

widow.en: And they were women: pregnant women, unmarried mothers, widows, or women whose husbands had abandoned them.
widow.zh: 他们是女性：孕妇、未婚母亲、寡妇，或是被丈夫抛弃的妇女。

widow.en: In any case, he left behind a widow and six children.
widow.zh: 无论如何，他留下了一个遗孀和六个孩子。

widow.en: Now, after Germanicus’s death, his widow openly accused Tiberius of murder, which was not a particularly smart thing to do, especially to an emperor as malicious and sadistic as Tiberius.
widow.zh: 在 Germanicus 去世后，他的遗孀公开指控 Tiberius 谋杀，这可不是什么明智之举，特别是对像 Tiberius 这样恶毒残暴的皇帝而言。

witness.en: I think I did, but not lessons that were taught, lessons that were witnessed.
witness.zh: 我想我学到了，但不是被教导的教训，而是被见证的教训。

witness.en: He was a witness for a long time. What he learned won't just go away.
witness.zh: 他当了很久的见证人。他学到的东西不会凭空消失。

witness.en: The Planks were a neighboring family of Jehovah's Witnesses, a mom, a dad, and two daughters.
witness.zh: Plank一家是邻居，也是耶和华见证人，包括爸爸、妈妈和两个女儿。

witness.en: Or, as Goebbels neatly put it, “You have been in a damn hurry to get your witnesses below ground."
witness.zh: 或者，正如戈培尔精辟地说的那样：“你们可真够着急把证人送进地底下的。”

witness.en: In Chile, Darwin witnessed a very powerful earthquake.
witness.zh: 在智利，Darwin亲历了一场非常强烈的地震。

windy.en: There are some obvious reasons. From the 1960s onwards, cheap flights and package holidays meant that British holidaymakers increasingly jetted off for the south of Spain rather than sitting on a windy beach in northern England.
windy.zh: 这其中有一些显而易见的原因。从 1960 年代起，廉价航班和包价旅游意味着英国度假者越来越多地坐飞机前往西班牙南部，而不是坐在英格兰北部风刮个不停的海滩上。

wicked.en: They say it is satire, not instruction. They say Punch has always been a wicked character, and that the joke is on him, not on his victims.
wicked.zh: 他们说这是讽刺，而不是教导。他们说 Punch 一直是个邪恶的角色，笑话是在他身上，而不是在他的受害者身上。

wipe.en: Odysseus, the great Greek warrior, is forced to wipe the tears from his eyes.
wipe.zh: 奥德修斯这位伟大的希腊勇士，强忍着擦去了眼角的泪水。

wipe.en: And I constantly have to kind of wipe the slime off me of this sense that I need to prove myself.
wipe.zh: 我必须不断地擦掉我身上那种需要证明自己的粘液。

wipe.en: Some come too close, like the one that is thought to have hit Earth and wiped out the dinosaurs 66 million years ago.
wipe.zh: 有些靠得太近了，就像那颗被认为在 6600 万年前撞击地球并导致恐龙灭绝的小行星一样。

width.en: Asteroids are smaller, typically ranging from a few hundred metres or so through to the largest known asteroid, which is almost 1,000 kilometres in diameter, around the same width as France from its most northern to most southern point.
width.zh: 小行星较小，直径通常从几百米不等，一直到已知最大的一颗小行星——它的直径接近 1,000 公里，大致相当于法国从最北端到最南端的宽度。

wield.en: In 2025, it was used to refer to a small, powerful group of tech billionaires who wield huge political influence.
wield.zh: 在2025年，它被用来指代一小撮拥有巨大政治影响力的权势滔天的科技亿万富翁。

wield.en: For better or for worse, he reshaped the expectations of what a Vice President could do and laid the groundwork for future VPs to wield substantial power.
wield.zh: 不管好坏，他重塑了人们对副总统职权范围的期望，并为后来的副总统掌握实权奠定了基础。

withstand.en: So when you do more volume, your ability to withstand volume, your work capacity increases.
withstand.zh: 所以当你增加训练量时，你承受训练量的能力，即你的工作能力就会增加。

withstand.en: There is absolutely no way a human body could withstand that sort of pressure; our organs would be instantly crushed, we would be compressed to a fraction of our normal size and, to state the obvious, instantly killed.
withstand.zh: 人类的身体绝对无法承受这种压力；我们的器官会被瞬间压碎，我们会压缩到正常体型的一小部分，显而易见，会瞬间死亡。

withstand.en: In fact, in his account, De Marchi would write that the limit to how long a diver could stay underwater with this invention was nothing to do with how much air there was left, but rather how long the diver could withstand the cold of the water and the fatigue of wearing this heavy contraption on their head.
withstand.zh: 事实上，德马基在记述中写道，潜水员使用这项发明在水下停留时间的限制，与剩余多少空气无关，而是取决于潜水员能忍受多久的水温寒冷，以及头上戴着这个沉重装置的疲劳程度。

wise.en: And it's so wise, powerful, but beautiful.
wise.zh: 它既充满智慧、力量，又非常优美。

wise.en: On that, I've heard you say, you talk about the difference between seeming wise and being wise, that you tried to appear smart as a kid by sort of- Still do. rote memorization masquerading as insight and wisdom and uh i i'd certainly feel that you know a lot of the show for me i think has been was and still is a redemption arc from this you know decade of my life where i completely suppressed any intellectual curiosity it's like okay i'll be a professional party boy for 10 years stand on the front door of a nightclub and give out vip wristbands and have access to all of the pretty girls or you know the cool parties or whatever it might be seems like it worked out okay it did in some ways i mean it's not fun it's it was look it was a good way to spend my 20s but to sort of come back above put your head above water two degrees one of which was a master's and then this like just shut down any of that learn i mean i did that while i was at uni while i was at uni i was running the events so it was actually a decade and a half uh Uh...
wise.zh: 关于这一点，我听你说过，你谈到了看起来睿智和真正睿智之间的区别，你小时候试图通过某种方式显得聪明——现在依然如此。死记硬背伪装成洞察力和智慧，我当然感觉到了，你知道，对我来说，这个节目的很多内容，我想曾经是，现在依然是一个救赎弧线，来自我生命中那十年，我完全压抑了任何求知欲，就像，好吧，我做十年的专业派对男孩，站在夜店前门，分发VIP腕带，接触所有漂亮的女孩，或者你知道，酷派对什么的，看起来还行。在某些方面确实如此，我的意思是，这并不有趣，这是度过20岁的好方法，但要从那种状态中恢复过来，把头探出水面，两个学位，其中一个是硕士，然后这就像关闭了任何学习的欲望，我的意思是，我在大学时就这么做了，我在大学时负责组织活动，所以实际上是十五年……

wise.en: On that, I've heard you say, you talk about the difference between seeming wise and being wise, that you tried to appear smart as a kid by sort of- Still do. rote memorization masquerading as insight and wisdom and uh i i'd certainly feel that you know a lot of the show for me i think has been was and still is a redemption arc from this you know decade of my life where i completely suppressed any intellectual curiosity it's like okay i'll be a professional party boy for 10 years stand on the front door of a nightclub and give out vip wristbands and have access to all of the pretty girls or you know the cool parties or whatever it might be seems like it worked out okay it did in some ways i mean it's not fun it's it was look it was a good way to spend my 20s but to sort of come back above put your head above water two degrees one of which was a master's and then this like just shut down any of that learn i mean i did that while i was at uni while i was at uni i was running the events so it was actually a decade and a half uh Uh...
wise.zh: 关于这一点，我听你说过，你谈到了看起来睿智和真正睿智之间的区别，你小时候试图通过某种方式显得聪明——现在依然如此。死记硬背伪装成洞察力和智慧，我当然感觉到了，你知道，对我来说，这个节目的很多内容，我想曾经是，现在依然是一个救赎弧线，来自我生命中那十年，我完全压抑了任何求知欲，就像，好吧，我做十年的专业派对男孩，站在夜店前门，分发VIP腕带，接触所有漂亮的女孩，或者你知道，酷派对什么的，看起来还行。在某些方面确实如此，我的意思是，这并不有趣，这是度过20岁的好方法，但要从那种状态中恢复过来，把头探出水面，两个学位，其中一个是硕士，然后这就像关闭了任何学习的欲望，我的意思是，我在大学时就这么做了，我在大学时负责组织活动，所以实际上是十五年……

wither.en: In two months of the residency program, Katie's body and mind had withered.
wither.zh: 在住院医师培训项目的两个月里，Katie 的身心都日渐枯萎。

winding.en: And then it went down to $10,000. You could just feel it winding down.
winding.zh: 接着收入降到了10000美元。你简直能清晰地感觉到它在一步步走向衰亡。
